description:
What is This Part?
This is a 2 in 1 Tie-Down Kit that secures batteries of different sizes to the engine bay/battery compartment.
This deluxe kit gives you everything you need to successfully secure your battery no matter whether it is a larger domestic battery or a smaller import battery.
Maximum Battery Width – 6 7/8″
Minimum Battery Width – 4″
Maximum Battery Height – 7 1/4″
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Large Length Battery Tie-Down Bar
Qty 1 – Medium Length Battery Tie-Down Bar
Qty 1 – Long Threaded Tie-Down Hook Rods
Qty 1 – Short Threaded Tie-Down Hook Rods
Qty 2 – Nuts & Washers for Tie-Down Hook Rods
Qty 2 – Flange Bolts and Flange Nuts for L Bracket Installation (washer pictured replaced by Flange Bolts & Nuts)
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki SJ410 1980 – 1984 All Models
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1988 All Models
